component.name: logitech-sim-led
component.summary: Telemetry to Logitech wheel LED service

description.p: Cross-platform background service that ingests racing-game telemetry (Forza Horizon 5/6, Forza Motorsport) and drives the RPM shift-light LEDs on a Logitech G27/G29/G923 wheel. Runs in the background with a local web UI for live telemetry; no Logitech G HUB required.
